composition: Levanto beach and harbor with pastel Ligurian façades and green hills · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The viewpoint is above the beach looking along the bay, the turquoise sea filling the left with bathers scattered across the grey pebble shore at the lower right. Pastel Ligurian palazzi — rose, ochre, and pale blue — line the waterfront at the right center, backed by steep green hills dotted with villas. At 12:00 the midday sun is brilliant, and the whole bay glows with summer color.
